Build a landing page for Crumb & Co., a small-batch bakery in Accra, Ghana (https://instagram.com/crumbandco). We sell sourdough loaves, custom celebration cakes and weekend pastry boxes, and we deliver across Accra. Our customers are busy young professionals and families who want something special for birthdays and weekends. Brand: warm, friendly, a little playful. Colours: terracotta #C2410C, cream #FFF8F1 and a deep brown #3B2314. We have no logo, please make a simple wordmark from the name. Fonts: Fraunces for headlines and Inter for body text.

Sections: hero, how ordering works (pick, pay, we deliver), best-sellers with prices (Sourdough loaf GHS 45, Celebration cake from GHS 320, Weekend pastry box GHS 120), why us, testimonials, FAQ (how early to order, delivery areas, allergies), a custom cake order form, and a footer.

Headline: "Fresh from our oven to your Saturday." Main action: Order a cake for this weekend. Contact: hello@crumbandco.com, +233 24 123 4567. Opening hours Tue to Sun, 7am to 6pm. Use my own product photos (I'll attach them). No stock photos. Mobile first and accessible.
